card.title: First to Solve It
card.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.

transfer.action: I compare your new clue with the tracking entry beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Tracking says reception. I've solved the whole building while you were still refreshing. {request}
transfer.response: One stayed downstairs, then. I've narrowed it to one desk. {counter}
transfer.challenge: The trolley's here. There's a box wedged underneath.
transfer.closing: So it left reception but never got unloaded. You've found the parcel; I've solved why we've been calling reception all morning.

originalTransfer.action: I put my initials beside the new clue on {prop}.
originalTransfer.opening: Found it first. Write that down. {request}
originalTransfer.response: You can catch up after I've tested the answer. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: My pencil was already numbering the together part.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
